implementation: Owned boundary/followup namespace routing before generic time/Focus handling; strict region receipt or one-shot UTC calendar-trigger decoding
Fresh account/session/task generation/completion, private place/journal, device consent and cancellation checks; unknown actions ignored
Open route rereads protected state and is fenced again after its asynchronous scene validation
Complete/Tomorrow co-save a local spent-response receipt atomically with normal task mutations; both current memory and last durable cache reject replay
Explicit snoozes keep a fixed target, use a separate ls1 namespace and share the serialized time/Focus/location budget; waiting target survives refresh/relaunch
Reserve before native add, acknowledge after acceptance, adopt matching pending proof after a missed acknowledgement, never automatically resubmit ambiguous/consumed opportunities
A proved no-room refusal releases its reservation to retry the same target; failed reservations never reach the OS; obsolete held additions are removed
Re-snooze consumes the former followup and creates a distinct explicit time request without changing/rearming the task boundary reference
Both private native categories require authentication for their three actions; normal iOS row explains current snooze date/time
Both Stores make re-entry into the already-readable local workspace idempotent, preserving its session/alerts while genuine switches retain cleanup
Both repos independently own validated optional local ledger models/queue semantics; no sibling build dependency, backend migration or release activation
